title: Messi Scores, but Inter Miami Loses to Columbus Crew
seoTitle: Messi Scores, Inter Miami Falls to Columbus Crew
subtitle: The Argentine star scored the equalizer, but the loss distances the team from the conference lead.
excerpt: Lionel Messi scored his 21st goal of the season, but Inter Miami fell 2-1 to the Columbus Crew, widening the gap to the conference leader.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Inter Miami suffered a 2-1 defeat to the Columbus Crew on Sunday night, a match that once again put Lionel Messi's name in the spotlight. The result widened the club's gap from the Eastern Conference leader and kept the playoff race alive.

Messi Scores Equalizer from Free-Kick

In the 33rd minute, Messi converted a free-kick, equalizing the score after Josef Martínez's penalty goal in the 28th minute. The goal was Messi's 21st of the regular season, keeping him in the MLS lead for goals.

Columbus Responds and Secures Victory

After the equalizer, the Crew pressed and, in stoppage time, Brais Méndez shot from outside the box, and goalkeeper Patrick Schulte couldn't hold on. Jamal Thiaré capitalized on the rebound and scored the winning goal in the ninth minute of added time.

Messi's Season Performance

In addition to his 21 goals, Messi also leads the league in assists with 13, a number he shares with four other players. The Argentine has been Inter Miami's leading scorer, with the team having only one win in their last ten games.

Impact on MLS Standings

With the defeat, Inter Miami fell 14 points behind leader Nashville, with seven regular season matches still to play. The Columbus Crew remains in 12th position with 29 points, four points away from a playoff spot.

Outlook for the Rest of the Season

The result leaves Inter Miami with fragile hopes of reaching the top of the conference, while Columbus continues its fight for a playoff spot. Both clubs still have decisive matches ahead to determine their future in the competition.

With information from AFP.com, Bozeman Daily Chronicle.
